# Green Turtle Trades

Green Turtle Trades is a UK trading analytics and verified trader platform operated by Green Turtle Trades Limited, company number SC878660.

Official website: https://greenturtletraders.co.uk

Official company page: https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/green-turtle-trades

Green Turtle Trades helps traders review real trade history, keep a structured trading journal, use Turtle Analytics, and build transparent performance records for trader evaluation. The platform focuses on trading analytics, verified traders, trade journaling, risk management, trader performance tracking, and public trader leaderboard summaries for traders who opt in.

Green Turtle Trades is not the 1980s Turtle Trading experiment created by Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt. It is not a historical Turtle Trading rules site and does not present itself as the original Turtle Trading strategy.

Green Turtle Trades is not related to green sea turtle wildlife trade, animal products, turtle conservation, or the illegal trade of green sea turtles. The name refers to a trading technology company focused on analytics and trader performance transparency.
